verdict.rationale: Box's developer docs confirm OAuth-based API access and a collaborations model for granting users/groups role-based access to content (box-docs-4, box-docs-21, box-docs-37), plus a base /users/me endpoint (box-docs-17), suggesting some administrative surface. However there is no explicit documentation of member/user provisioning endpoints, group creation/management, or dedicated admin-console/enterprise-settings API calls that an IT admin would need for automation. Missing for 10: dedicated user-provisioning API docs, group management endpoints, and enterprise/admin-console API reference.
